verdict.rationale: Letta's docs show memory is stored as plain Markdown files inside a Git-backed 'memory repository' (letta-docs-11) and shared memory is explicitly a Git repo (letta-docs-21, letta-docs-29), and agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control with state kept on your own machine (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-31), which supports portability and avoids opaque lock-in. However, there's no explicit documented 'export' or 'import' command, no described backup/migration workflow, and no independent verification that this git/markdown representation round-trips cleanly between cloud and self-hosted deployments. Missing for 10: dedicated export/import CLI or API, explicit backup/restore documentation, and third-party confirmation of format portability across environments.
